body:
Found while surveying, not requested — filing rather than fixing.

The Add-another button was removed from the Android add-item dialog (the
buttons are now just Cancel and Add, deliberately close together). The web item
dialog still has it: ItemDialog.performSave(closeAfter) keeps the save-and-reset
path and handleSaveAndAddAnother still renders a button for it.

So the two clients now offer different buttons in the same dialog. Either the
web one goes too, or Android gets it back. [[T-140]] makes the burst-add
workflow cheaper on both clients, which weakens the case for keeping it.

Needs a decision, not implementation.
title: web still has Add another; Android no longer does
